title: Root Cause Pathway Canvas (interactive error-flow prototyping)
creator: Riley Chen
description: Design an interactive Canvas in the Redwood Console that helps engineers rapidly trace a failed request through its causal pathway, surface likely root causes, and provide contextual payload inspection and retry visualization. The Canvas combines a compact timeline, an event graph (service/model/route nodes), and an inline payload diff/preview so users can go from symptom to mitigation in a single surface. This ticket contains the prototype scope, interaction rules, and review notes for handoff to frontend and product engineering.
user_stories: As an SRE, I want to see a condensed path of retries and model fallbacks for a given request so I can quickly determine if the problem is transient or systemic.
As an engineer, I want to open a payload inspector side sheet from any step in the pathway and compare request/response pairs to locate malformed inputs.
As a PM, I want the Canvas to highlight anomaly signals (latency spikes, token cost regressions) inline so I can correlate regressions with recent rollouts.
As a support engineer, I want to add annotations and tag a pathway with a saved runbook link to speed future TTRs.
As an engineer on Dedicated, I want an explicit indicator when a retry crossed a different capacity tier or model variant so it is clear why behavior changed.
acceptance_criteria: Clickable Canvas prototype in Figma with at least three example request pathways (simple success, single retry, multi-fallback cascade).
Payload inspector panel designs covering raw payload, parsed JSON view, side-by-side diff, and quick-copy snippets.
Interaction spec: hover previews for nodes, scrubber-controlled timeline, node expansion animation, and keyboard navigation for accessibility.
Annotated handoff doc with required telemetry events and backend API shapes (list of event types, timestamps, node metadata) suitable for ENG-20121 to implement.
Usability testing script and notes from at least 3 sessions showing reduced time-to-identify-root-cause vs current Console flow.
Design tokens and responsive rules for Canvas at 1280px and 1440px, with mobile fallback behavior documented.
design_notes: Key decisions: prioritize a single-pane investigative flow over multiple modal handoffs to reduce context switching. We group events by semantic buckets (API route, model variant, capacity tier, infra error) and collapse low-signal retries by default. The payload inspector defaults to parsed JSON and exposes a raw toggle for binary artifacts. Accessibility: ensure keyboard scrubbing and ARIA labels for node types. Performance trade-off: rendering large KV caches inline will be paginated and capped (see telemetry notes).
tradeoffs: Inline payload diffs increase front-end rendering complexity; mitigated by server-side pre-compute of diff hunks (requires ENG-20345 support).
Condensing retries reduces visible chronology; provide expanded timeline toggle to reveal full event stream when needed.
Surface-level root-cause hints are heuristics and may mislead; include explicit confidence scores and links to raw traces so engineers can verify.
